In CNIL’s practical AI guidance sheets, age information should be handled by prioritizing the least intrusive format without losing relevant information. For example, using age or age ranges instead of complete birth dates is recommended. 

In the context of a diagnosis-aid system, it is suggested to generalize age information to formats like [month-year] or [year] instead of [day-month-year]. This approach significantly reduces the risk of loss of confidentiality while maintaining the system's ability to generalize effectively.
